pages.text: The $(bold)Recipe Memory Box$() stores craft patterns so your machines can reuse them without retyping. Teach it a pattern once)Skip; later you can reference it from your $(l:s3_advanced:automation/auto_crafter)Auto-Crafter$() and related automation.
It keeps a small set of pattern slots. When paired with the rest of your network, remembered patterns let you trigger the same craft repeatedly — a core part of any automated storage setup.
